rv.q: Marconi has delivered a performance of staggering emotional magnitude—one so fearless, so physically exhilarating, and so spiritually devastating that it lingers long after the lights have faded.
This was one of those performances that will stay with you.
It is a work of emotional and intellectual resonance, threaded with humor, shadowed by darkness, and guided by an unmistakably individual vision.

cn.t: Daniel Marconi delivers a spellbinding, soul-baring performance as a mentally unstable self-appointed savior in this gripping revival of Enda Walsh's one-man psychological breakdown, leaving audiences transfixed by his complete transformation.
